items.html: However, although this aspect was so, there is a certain change in it during the aforementioned period, and it is as the Sages said: that the first man removed the Shechina to the first firmament, and the generation of Enosh, etc., until they raised it above the seven firmaments; until Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Levi, Kehat, Amram, and Moses came and brought it down below the firmaments, as at first.
